t1.author: Maya Krüger
t1.title: Comment by Maya Krüger
t1.text: Can we commit to these delivery dates, or do we need a buffer week?
t1.quote: on “delivery dates set out in Schedule 2”

t2.author: Jonas Weber
t2.title: Comment by Jonas Weber
t2.text: Finance asked for 45 days instead of 30.
t2.quote: on “within 30 days of the invoice date”

t3.author: Lena Fischer
t3.title: Comment by Lena Fischer
t3.text: Is the cap per incident or per contract year?

t4.author: Tom Becker
t4.title: Comment by Tom Becker
t4.text: Three months seems short for a supplier of this size.

t5.author: Sara Nowak
t5.title: Comment by Sara Nowak
t5.text: Link the adjustment to the published index, not to the supplier's costs.

t6.author: Paul Martin
t6.title: Comment by Paul Martin
t6.text: Add response times for priority 1 incidents.

t8.author: Jonas Weber
t8.title: Comment by Jonas Weber
t8.text: Does this cover the price list as well?

t9.author: Tom Becker
t9.title: Comment by Tom Becker
t9.text: Can we get 24 months for the hardware?

t11.author: Sara Nowak
t11.title: Comment by Sara Nowak
t11.text: Once a year with 30 days' notice?

t12.author: Paul Martin
t12.title: Comment by Paul Martin
t12.text: Cap the penalties at 10% of the order value.
